indexes.//: Powers listMyInvites() in src/data/workspaces.ts — a collection-group query across every workspace's invites subcollection for the signed-in user's email. Firestore cannot serve a collection-group filter without an explicit index.
Powers listBackups() — snapshots newest first, per workspace.

fieldOverrides.//: The board and snapshot payloads are large JSON strings that are never queried. Exempting them from indexing avoids the 1500-byte index-entry limit and cuts storage cost.
